meta.title: Lab tests: VO₂max, lactate profile, training zones
meta.description: VO₂max, lactate profile, fat and carbohydrate use, running economy and anthropometry. What each test measures, how to prepare and what it costs.

hero.title: Lab testing
hero.subtitle: Know your numbers. A lab test shows where you really are and gives you training zones based on your own body, not on formulas.

what.title: What is a lab test?
what.text: You run or ride at increasing intensity while your body's response is measured: heart rate, the oxygen you use and, from a drop of blood, your lactate. The result is a precise picture of your endurance: your thresholds, your VO₂max and the zones you should train in.

why.title: Why test?
why.zones: Train at the right intensity, with zones from your own thresholds instead of age formulas.
why.progress: See real progress: a retest shows exactly what has changed.
why.race: Race smarter, knowing the pace or power you can hold.

choose.title: Which test is right for me?
choose.lactate: Your first test, and you want training zones: lactate profile.
choose.vo2max: You want to know your aerobic ceiling: VO₂max test.
choose.combined: You want the most accurate zones: VO₂max + lactate.
choose.fatCarb: You train for long races: fat and carbohydrate use.
choose.economy: You're a runner looking for efficiency: running economy.
choose.performance: You want everything in one visit: Performance package.

prepare.title: How to prepare
prepare.text: Your booking confirmation includes the preparation for your test. In short: come rested, with no hard training in the 24 hours before, and fasted for the fat and carbohydrate test and the Performance package.

location.title: Where
location.text: You get the address of the test in your booking confirmation.

after.title: After the test
after.text: You get your results explained and, from the lactate and VO₂max tests, your personal training zones.
after.offer: Every test ends with an offer: {days} days of Plan for free, or your first month of Coaching at −{percent} %.
